lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately four distinct vertical columns of spots visible on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to create a semi-regular checkerboard pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are notably smaller in diameter than those on the primary lateral flank.
